word-sadness.def: the feeling of being unhappy, often after a loss

word-anger.def: the strong feeling you have when something seems unfair or wrong

word-shame.def: a painful feeling of embarrassment about something bad you did

word-guilt.def: the bad feeling you have when you know you did something wrong

word-pride.def: a good feeling about your own achievements or those of people close to you

word-envy.def: the unhappy wish to have what someone else has

word-loneliness.def: the sad feeling of being alone without friends or company

word-happiness.def: the feeling of being glad and pleased with your life

word-cheerful.def: showing a bright, positive mood that makes others feel good

word-depressed.def: very unhappy and without hope for a long time

word-relaxed.def: calm and free from worry or tension

word-stressed.def: worried and tense because of too much pressure

word-ashamed.def: feeling embarrassed and bad about something you did

word-guilty.def: feeling bad because you did something wrong, or responsible for a crime

word-confident.def: sure about your own abilities and decisions

word-optimistic.def: expecting good things to happen in the future

word-sensitive.def: quick to notice other people's feelings or to be hurt by things

word-romantic.def: connected with love, or showing love in a sweet, dreamy way

word-selfish.def: caring only about your own needs and not about others

word-greedy.def: wanting much more food, money or things than you need

word-stubborn.def: refusing to change your mind or your way of doing things

word-responsible.def: doing your duty and able to be trusted, or in charge of something

word-reliable.def: able to be trusted to do what is promised

word-ambitious.def: having a strong wish to succeed or reach a high position

word-independent.def: able to live and decide things without help from others

word-modest.def: not talking proudly about your own successes

word-arrogant.def: acting as if you are better than other people

word-naive.def: trusting people too easily because you lack experience

word-cruel.def: causing pain or suffering to others on purpose

word-charming.def: pleasant and attractive in a way that people like

word-annoying.def: making you feel slightly angry or impatient

word-admire.def: to respect and like someone for their qualities or achievements

word-regret.def: to feel sorry about something you did or did not do

word-cheer-up.def: to become happier, or to make someone feel happier

word-fall-in-love.def: to begin to have deep romantic feelings for someone

word-break-up.def: to end a romantic relationship with someone

word-comfort.def: to say or do kind things to make someone feel less sad

word-inat.gl: inat: Serbian word for stubborn defiance, acting out of spite

word-saudade.gl: saudade: Portuguese word for deep longing for someone or something absent

word-gezellig.gl: gezellig: Dutch word for cozy, pleasant and friendly

word-schadenfreude.gl: Schadenfreude: German word for pleasure at someone else's misfortune

word-amae.gl: amae: Japanese word for the wish to be indulged and depend on another's goodwill

word-lagom.gl: lagom: Swedish ideal of just the right amount, not too much or too little

word-craic.gl: craic: Irish word for fun, good company and lively conversation
